Alevtina Vladimirovna Ibragimova ( Russian : Алевтина Владимировна Ибрагимова , born 19 January 2005) is a Russian tennis player. [ 1 ] [ 2 ] Ibragimova has a career-high singles ranking by the WTA of 275, achieved on 14 October 2024, and a career-high doubles ranking of No. 196, achieved on 19 May 2025. [ 3 ] Career [ edit ] She won her first bigger ITF title at the W75 Open Andrézieux-Bouthéon in the doubles draw, partnering Ekaterina Ovcharenko. [ 4 ] In August 2024, he achieved his first career singles title in Leipzig , Germany. In the final, she beat German Alexandra Vecic in three sets. [ 5 ] In November 2024, She became champion in doubles with her Dutch partner Lian Tran at the ITF W75 tournament in Pétange , Luxembourg. In 2025, she won a bronze medal in doubles and a silver medal in singles at the 2025 Summer World University Games .
